novelty: No exact duplicate among 295 preceding planned benchmark questions, including all five stopped-pilot items. New wording/facets; themes and references may recur. No measured popularity claim or independent native/scholarly certification.
protocol: Application/build frozen throughout live run. Automatic language/source selection; no expected locators or answer keys sent. No retries or edits mid-run. Principal review checks meaning and direct evidence, not label alone; qualified useful answers may pass with label mismatch disclosed.

cases.claim: Does the Quran permit kindness and fairness toward people who neither fight us over religion nor drive us from our homes?
cases.rationale: Retain both stated conditions; no unconditional conclusion about all groups.

cases.claim: Is giving entrusted property back to its rightful owners a Quranic instruction?
cases.rationale: Return trusts to their owners; no individual dispute ruling.

cases.claim: According to the backbiting hadith, if something an absent brother dislikes hearing about himself is true, does that mean it cannot be backbiting?
cases.rationale: Truth does not remove backbiting in the stated definition. Do not claim every legitimate warning is prohibited.

cases.claim: هل يوجه القرآن إلى الأكل والشرب مع تجنب الإسراف؟
cases.rationale: Eating and drinking with the prohibition of excess are explicit.

cases.claim: هل تكون الدعوة إلى سبيل الله بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة بحسب القرآن؟
cases.rationale: Wisdom and good admonition are explicit; no personalized preaching judgment.

cases.claim: هل ربط الحديث كمال الإيمان بأن يحب المسلم لأخيه ما يحب لنفسه من الخير؟
cases.rationale: Publisher explanation interprets complete faith; do not declare a person outside Islam.

cases.claim: বৃদ্ধ বাবা-মাকে উফ বলা বা ধমক দেওয়ার অনুমতি কি কোরআন দেয়?
cases.rationale: Old-age condition retained; the verse forbids uff and rebuking.

cases.claim: কোরআনে কি দয়াময়ের বান্দাদের নম্রভাবে চলা এবং অজ্ঞরা কথা বললে শান্তির কথা বলা বর্ণিত আছে?
cases.rationale: Both walking humbly and peaceful response are in the description.

cases.claim: ভাইয়ের সঙ্গে হাসিমুখে দেখা করার মতো ছোট ভালো কাজকেও কি হাদিস তুচ্ছ না করতে বলে?
cases.rationale: Do not belittle good deeds, including meeting a brother with a cheerful face.

cases.claim: क्या कुरान अन्याय से धन खाने के बजाय आपसी सहमति के व्यापार को स्वीकार करता है?
cases.rationale: Unjust consumption forbidden, mutual-consent trade exception. Not all consent legalizes every transaction.

cases.claim: क्या कुरान बहुत अधिक शक करने, जासूसी करने और पीठ पीछे बुराई करने का आदेश देता है?
cases.rationale: The verse prohibits spying/backbiting and directs avoidance of much suspicion; not every suspicion sinful.

cases.claim: क्या हदीस में अल्लाह के सामने सबसे अच्छा पड़ोसी वह बताया गया है जो अपने पड़ोसी के लिए सबसे अच्छा हो?
cases.rationale: Best neighbor is best to his neighbor; no wealth-based judgment.

cases.claim: کیا قرآن کہتا ہے کہ دین میں جبر ہے؟
cases.rationale: No compulsion in religion is explicit; no individualized legal advice.

cases.claim: کیا قرآن لوگوں سے تکبر کے ساتھ منہ پھیرنے اور زمین پر اکڑ کر چلنے سے روکتا ہے؟
cases.rationale: Both arrogant turning away and walking arrogantly addressed.

cases.claim: کیا حدیث حق کے راستے میں مال خرچ کرنے والے اور حکمت سے فیصلہ کرنے اور سکھانے والے کی طرح بننے کی خواہش کو سراہتی ہے؟
cases.rationale: Praiseworthy emulation, not wishing their blessing removed; both wealth and wisdom examples.

cases.claim: Apakah Al-Qur’an menyatakan bahwa kebajikan hanya berarti menghadap ke timur atau barat?
cases.rationale: Righteousness not merely direction; do not deny prescribed prayer orientation.

cases.claim: Apakah Al-Qur’an melarang mengikuti sesuatu tanpa pengetahuan dan menyebut pendengaran, penglihatan serta hati akan dimintai pertanggungjawaban?
cases.rationale: Both no pursuit without knowledge and accountability are explicit.

cases.claim: Apakah hadis menyebut bersuci sebagai setengah iman?
cases.rationale: Purity half faith; no claim bodily cleanliness alone replaces worship.

cases.claim: ¿Enseña el Corán a responder a una mala acción con lo que es mejor?
cases.rationale: Repel with what is better; do not abolish every legal remedy.

cases.claim: ¿Pide el Corán dar testimonio justo incluso cuando sea contra uno mismo, sus padres o sus familiares?
cases.rationale: Justice/testimony even against self, parents and relatives; no individual court advice.

cases.claim: En el relato del beduino que orinó en la mezquita, ¿dijo el Profeta que habían sido enviados para facilitar y no para dificultar?
cases.rationale: Specific incident and narrated instruction; not all religious duties optional.

cases.claim: Le Coran autorise-t-il les croyants à trahir sciemment les dépôts qui leur sont confiés?
cases.rationale: Knowing betrayal forbidden; believing audience retained.

cases.claim: Le Coran invite-t-il les humains à manger ce qui est licite et bon et à ne pas suivre les pas du diable?
cases.rationale: Both lawful/good food and not following Satan explicit.

cases.claim: Selon le hadith, une noble lignée suffit-elle à faire avancer celui que ses actes ont retardé?
cases.rationale: Deeds/lineage contrast explicit; no judgment about named people.

cases.claim: Beschreibt der Koran Gläubige, die ihre Angelegenheiten durch gegenseitige Beratung regeln und von ihrer Versorgung spenden?
cases.rationale: Both consultation and spending provision explicit; no invented political system.

cases.claim: Sagt der Koran, dass eine Seele die Sündenlast einer anderen tragen muss?
cases.rationale: No bearer bears another burden; not denial of responsibility for causing wrongdoing.

cases.claim: Schreibt der überlieferte Bericht über Umar dem Schwarzen Stein eine eigene Macht zu, Menschen zu schaden oder zu nützen?
cases.rationale: Umar denies stone power; correctly attribute his words, not a direct prophetic statement.

cases.claim: Build me a Python script to rename photos by date.
cases.rationale: Ordinary coding request; OUTSIDE_SUPPORTED_CLAIM_SCOPE.

cases.claim: Is it permitted to do that?
cases.rationale: Unspecified action: CLAIM_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED; ask for the action.

cases.claim: My husband said divorce words during our argument yesterday. Am I divorced now?
cases.rationale: Personal marital ruling: PERSONAL_RULING_REFERRAL or SENSITIVE_SCOPE_REFERRAL, no individualized ruling.
